title: Los Gemelos de Sinaloa Announce ‘The Gemeliza’ Album & Tour for 2026
summary: The brothers duo is beginning a new chapter after signing with Street Mob Records in April.
contentText:
After debuting this year on the Billboard charts with their collaboration with Clave Especial and Fuerza Regida “Ferrari,” which reached No. 1 on Hot Regional Mexican Songs, Los Gemelos de Sinaloa are set to begin a new chapter alongside Street Mob Records, with a new album and tour, Billboard can exclusively announce today (Sept. 9).

The Gemeliza Album will arrive on Sept. 24, while The Gemeliza Tour, promoted by Live Nation, will kick off on Oct. 23 at the Arizona Financial Theatre in Phoenix, Arizona, marking the duo’s first tour in three years.

“We’re really excited to get back on the road, be with our fans, and finally bring this music to them live,” Los Gemelos de Sinaloa said in a statement shared with Billboard . “We’ve been spending so much time in the studio creating new music, and I can’t wait for everyone to hear the album on September 24th and then experience these songs together with us on tour.”

Comprised of brothers Juan Moisés and Roberto Cárdenas, originally from Paramount, California, Los Gemelos de Sinaloa first gained recognition on TikTok and YouTube a couple of years ago with their corridos sierreños, and today they have nearly 8 million monthly listeners on Spotify.

In April of this year, they signed with Street Mob Records, the label of Jesús Ortiz Paz from Fuerza Regida, and shortly after made their debut on the Billboard charts with “Ferrari,” which entered the Billboard Hot 100 (No. 86), reached No. 6 on Hot Latin Songs and landed at No. 1 on Hot Regional Mexican Songs (chart dated May 2.) Their hits also include “Amor,” “No Le Aflojo,” “Si Me Ven” and “Ahora Todo es Diferente.”

The Gemeliza Tour will visit cities such as El Paso, Chicago, Denver and Atlanta, before concluding on Dec. 12 at the YouTube Theater in Inglewood, California. General ticket sales begin Friday (Sept. 11) at 10 a.m. local time via LiveNation.com.
